about_the_game:
Goldrot is a space rover colony sim with roguelike elements. Build and manage rovers, explore asteroids for gold, and adapt to unpredictable conditions.

Gameplay

Every run starts small. You deploy rovers, gather resources, and expand your operations across procedurally generated asteroids. Harsh conditions, limited power, and unexpected events will constantly force you to adapt your strategy.

Failure is part of the process. Each run teaches you more about the systems, the hazards, and how to push deeper into asteroid fields in the next attempt.

Features

  • Colony simulation focused on managing fleets of space rovers

  • Explore and mine procedurally generated asteroids for gold

  • Roguelite structure with unpredictable conditions and repeatable runs

  • Build, upgrade, and specialize rovers for different tasks

  • Resource management under constant environmental pressure

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3-2100 / AMD A8-5600k
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 630 / Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-650 / AMD A10-5800K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 650 / Radeon HD 7510
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
